workspaceForm.ssoMapDesc1: Map your identity provider's groups to roles below. You only need to map the roles you use — <1>at least one</1> mapping is required, the rest can be left blank.
workspaceForm.ssoMapDesc2: Enter the value(s) your identity provider sends in the user's <1>groups</1> claim. <2>Google Workspace</2> returns group <3>names</3>. <4>Microsoft Entra</4> returns the group <5>Object ID</5>. <6>Okta</6> and most other providers return the group <7>name</7> (depending on how your groups attribute statement is configured). <8>Shibboleth</8> releases the value from your <9>isMemberOf</9>, <10>eduPersonEntitlement</10>, or <11>eduPersonScopedAffiliation</11> attribute (e.g. <12>staff@your.edu</12>, a Grouper path, or a group name/DN). Matching is trimmed and case-insensitive, but paste the value(s) exactly as your IdP sends them.
workspaceForm.ssoMapDesc3: Each field accepts <1>one or more group IDs, separated by commas</1> (e.g. <2>it-admins, org-admins</2>) — useful when more than one IdP group should map to the same role.
